recordings.name: knight_tyme.tzx
recordings.role: tape, not a recording: the archive's (128K)[Magic Knight 3].tzx, staged beside the snapshot for its loading screen (knight_tyme.find_screen); selftest.stage copies only the snapshot and the recordings list

verify.note: needs NEXCLASH_NEXT_ROM (NextZXOS's enNextZX.rom): the lockstep reads ROM 1 from alt image 1 as the Next fills it (NextZXOS's ROM3, then the build), and the previous-build negative needs it. auto: plain + sprite build, boot check, the loading stub run on a model; lockstep of the whole 128K machine per frame against the original on all four recordings (hook instructions counted as nothing; sprite layer and ULA against the model at stable frames, registers at every hook exit, crew layer on the Bridge), unit tests (figure cases, pool full, window pictures), 19 negatives (kt_cmds 1500 frames; the crew ones on kt_t1 1500 frames)

pin.note: the shared ROM path check (nextboot.rom_paths) replays the recordings on SkoolKit's 128K ROMs; these were recorded with Sinclair's 48K ROM as ROM 1 (games/knight_tyme.md Inputs: the 128K ROM 1 has keypad code at 0x386E), so it desyncs at frame 1 and its SkoolKitError aborts auto. A pin makes cmd_auto skip it (no altrom_fill: the build writes its whole alt ROM image itself, altrom 0x2000-0x4000 + altrom_low, so z80tonex.altrom_whole is False either way). The engine's lockstep runs ROM 1 from the image the Next holds instead. Alt image 0 is still the setup's copy of the Next's ROM 0 (REFACTOR item 2: the Bridge star map): `altrom0` is an opt-in rework, not this build
